# set up

## load packages
```{r echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
# loading packages
package_loader <- function(x) {
  if (x %in% installed.packages()) {
    suppressMessages({
      library(x, character.only = TRUE)
    })
  } else {
    suppressMessages({
      install.packages(x)
      library(x, character.only = TRUE)
    })
  }
}
```

## sites, parameters, and plots
```{r echo=FALSE}
if ({
  require(systemfonts)
  ("Roboto" %in% system_fonts()$family)
}) {
  ROSS_theme <- theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold', family = "Roboto"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, family = "Roboto"))
} else {
  message("You do not have the Roboto font family installed on your computer, currenly using ggplot default text family.
          See ROSS_themes.R for directions to install the font family on your computer.")
  ROSS_theme <- theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = 'bold'),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}


#Site names
site_names <- tibble(site = c("pbd", "bellvue", "salyer", "udall", "riverbend", "cottonwood" ,"elc",  "archery", "riverbluffs"), 
                     site_name = c("Canyon Mouth", "Tamasag", "Legacy", "Lincoln", "Timberline", "Prospect" ,"Boxelder",  "Archery", "River Bluffs"), 
                     site_color = c( "#000000" , "#185BB4","#009DD1","#00F5DC", "#00F0C0", "#00D684", "#00BD48",  "#00DB58", "#0FFF6B" ) )

#Site Order from up to downstream

site_order = c("Canyon Mouth", "Bellvue", "Salyer", "Udall", "Riverbend", "Cottonwood", "ELC", "Archery", "River Bluffs")


# Parameter labels
labels <- tibble(param = c("Turbidity", "Specific Conductivity", "Depth", "Chl-a Fluorescence", "FDOM Fluorescence", "Temperature", "DO", 'pH', "Flow"),
                 label = c("Turbidity (NTU)", "Specific Conductivity (uS/cm)", "Depth (ft)", "Chl-a Fluorescence (RFU)", "FDOM Fluorescence (RFU)", "Temperature (C)", "DO (mg/L)", 'pH', "Flow (cfs)"))


chem_expressions <- list(
  "Turbidity" = expression(Turbidity ~ (NTU)),
  "Chl-a Fluoresence"      = expression(Chl-a ~ Fluoresence ~ (RFU)),
  "FDOM Fluoresence"      = expression(FDOM ~ Fluoresence ~ (RFU)),
  "Specific Conductivity" = expression(Specific ~ Conductivity ~ (mu ~ S ~ cm^{-1})),
  "Depth"      = expression(Depth ~ (ft)),
  "Temperature" = expression(Temperature ~ (degree ~ C)),
  "DO"        = expression(DO ~ (mg ~ L^{-1})),
  "Flow"      = expression(Flow ~ (cfs)),
  "pH"        = expression(pH)
)


params <- paste(labels$param, collapse = "|")

```


# read in data

```{r echo=FALSE}
all_data <- list.files("operations/reporting/pwqn_data_report/data", pattern = "\\.csv$", 
                       full.names = TRUE) |> 
  map_df(read_csv)

pwqn_data <- all_data |>
  filter(value_final != "n/a") |> 
  mutate(DateTime_UTC = with_tz(DateTime_UTC, tz = "MST")) |> 
  rename(DateTime_MT = DateTime_UTC) |> 
  mutate(
    year = year(DateTime_MT),
    month = month(DateTime_MT),
    year_month = floor_date(DateTime_MT, unit = "month")) |> 
  left_join(labels, by = c( "parameter" = "param")) |> 
  left_join(site_names, by = "site") |> 
  filter(site_name != "NA")

pwqn_data_clean <- pwqn_data |>
  distinct(DateTime_MT, site_name, parameter, .keep_all = TRUE)

print(paste("Original records:", nrow(pwqn_data)))
print(paste("Records after removing duplicates:", nrow(pwqn_data_clean)))
print(paste("Duplicates removed:", nrow(pwqn_data) - nrow(pwqn_data_clean)))

check_duplicates <- pwqn_data_clean |>
  group_by(DateTime_MT, site_name, parameter) |>
  filter(n() > 1)

print(paste("Duplicates remaining:", nrow(check_duplicates)))

counts <- pwqn_data_clean |> 
  count(site = "archery", parameter = "pH", month = 2)

```


# Graphs
```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%"}
#yearly
yearly_percent <- pwqn_data_clean |> 
  group_by(year, parameter, site_name) |>
  summarise(actual_records = n(),
    .groups = 'drop') |> 
  mutate(expected_records = if_else(
      leap_year(year),
      366 * 24 * 60 / 15,
      365 * 24 * 60 / 15),
    data_pct = (actual_records / expected_records) * 100) |> 
  arrange(year)

yearly_plot <-  yearly_percent |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = data_pct, fill = site_name)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Data Availability by Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Availability (%)",
    fill = "Site") +
  ROSS_theme +
  ylim(0, 105)

yearly_plot


#monthly
monthly_percent <- pwqn_data_clean |> 
  mutate(month = month(DateTime_MT),
         year = year(DateTime_MT)) |> 
  group_by(year, month, parameter, site_name) |>
  summarise(actual_records = n(),
    .groups = 'drop') |> 
  mutate(days_in_month = case_when(
      month == 2 ~ if_else(year %in% c(2020,2024), 29,28),
      month %in% c(4, 6, 9, 11) ~ 30, TRUE ~ 31),
    expected_records = days_in_month * 24 * 60 / 15,
    data_pct = (actual_records / expected_records) * 100) |>
  group_by(month, parameter, site_name) |> 
  summarise(actual_records = mean(actual_records),
    expected_records = mean(expected_records),
    avg_data_pct = mean(data_pct),
    .groups = 'drop') |> 
  rename(data_pct = avg_data_pct) |> 
  mutate(month_name = factor(month.abb[month], levels = month.abb)) |> 
  arrange(month, parameter, site_name)

monthly_plot <- monthly_percent |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = month_name, y = data_pct, fill = site_name)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~parameter) +
  labs(title = "Average Monthly Data Availability",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Availability (%)",
    fill = "Site") +
  ROSS_theme +
  ylim(0, 105)

monthly_plot
```


# Heatmaps
```{r echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%"}
#yearly
yearly_heatmap <- yearly_percent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = site_name, fill = data_pct)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "green", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "Yearly Data Availability",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Site",
    fill = "Availability (%)") +
  ROSS_theme +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom")
 
print(yearly_heatmap)


#monthly
monthly_heatmap <- monthly_percent |>
  mutate(month_name = factor(month_name, levels = month.abb)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_name, y = site_name, fill = data_pct)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "green", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "Monthly Data Availability",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Site",
    fill = "Availability (%)") +
  ROSS_theme +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom")
 
print(monthly_heatmap)

```


#tables for percent of data available
```{r echo=FALSE}
#yearly
yearly_data_table_site <- yearly_percent |>
  group_by(year, parameter, site_name) |>
  summarise(avg_availability = mean(data_pct),
    min_availability = min(data_pct),
    max_availability = max(data_pct),
    .groups = 'drop') |> 
  mutate(avg_availability = round(avg_availability, 2),
    min_availability = round(min_availability, 2),
    max_availability = round(max_availability, 2))

yearly_site_flextable <- yearly_data_table_site |> 
  flextable() |> 
  set_header_labels(year = "Year",
    parameter = "Parameter",
    site_name = "Site",
    avg_availability = "Average Availability (%)",
    min_availability = "Minimum Availability (%)",
    max_availability = "Maximum Availability (%)") |> 
  colformat_num(j = "year",
    big.mark = "",
    digits = 0) |>
  colformat_num(j = c("avg_availability", "min_availability", "max_availability"),
    big.mark = "",
    digits = 2) |>
  theme_vanilla() |>
  autofit() |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  color(part = "header", color = "white") |>
  bg(part = "header", bg = "darkblue") |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  align(j = 1:3, align = "left")

print(yearly_site_flextable)

yearly_data_table <- yearly_percent |>
  group_by(year, parameter) |>
  summarise(avg_availability = mean(data_pct),
    min_availability = min(data_pct),
    max_availability = max(data_pct),
    .groups = 'drop') |> 
  mutate(avg_availability = round(avg_availability, 2),
    min_availability = round(min_availability, 2),
    max_availability = round(max_availability, 2))
```
